scope: Uniform all-field quadratic-anchor inverse-pair theorem and bilinear-defect corollary; sharp characteristic-zero prefix family. uniform_theorem.bilinear_defect_corollary: Monic quadratic in x plus rank(1,y,z,yz)<=3 gives sharp quadratic fan and cubic cost order.
uniform_theorem.coherence_essential: The number of order-ideal vector bases can be cubic.

priority_limits: Monotone lattice optimization is classical; Topkis (1978), doi:10.1287/opre.26.2.305, publisher abstract inspected. The proof here is self-contained. Exact numerical class-bound and sharp-count priority remains unassessed.
